title: How to Build an Event Ticketing App With AI
summary: Build a custom event ticketing app with AI—keep 100% of revenue instead of paying Eventbrite's 3.7% + $1.79 per ticket. Database, auth, and hosting included.
body_markdown: Blink generates the Stripe checkout flow, webhook handler, and payment confirmation logic automatically. You connect your Stripe account by pasting your live publishable and secret keys from your Stripe dashboard when prompted — Blink only accepts live keys, not test ones. Blink uses Stripe's hosted checkout page — no PCI compliance burden on your side, and refunds, disputes, and invoices are all managed through your Stripe dashboard.
